تلتهموا (form VIII)
# تَلْتَهِمُوا (taltahimū) /tal.ta.hi.muː/: second-person masculine plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِلْتَهَمَ (iltahama)
# تُلْتَهَمُوا (tultahamū) /tul.ta.ha.muː/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِلْتَهَمَ (iltahama)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
